text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was the final month of the Junior 
Class... As a culmination of everything so 
far, we decided to run 2000m.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was a slightly longer distance for the 
Junior Class, but the goal was to gauge 
her current potential with next year's 
Classic Class in mind—

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: —HAAAAAAAHH!!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: How was it!?
choice_data_list: You clocked a pretty great time! Look!
You clocked a pretty great time! Look!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: ! With this...!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: I can beat Ms. Gentile too—I know I can!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Yes. Finally...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having entered races appropriately and 
built up a good amount of experience up to 
this point, she's now overflowing with 
confidence and fulfillment...!
choice_data_list:
Next time—let's surpass them in the real 
race!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Yes!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
We were also able to demonstrate our 
potential for the road ahead, weren't we?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
If we keep training her like this, she 
should have no problem with the 2,400m 
'Oaks'. What do you think?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"From now on, please include more training 
geared specifically toward the Tokyo 
Racecourse track."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Along the Triple Tiara route, there are no 
left-handed GⅠ races until the main event. 
We will need to come up with special 
countermeasures.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Yes, I understand.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Let us begin. From the "Oka Sho"... our 
path to the summit!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
You two sure seem like you're in a good 
mood together~♡

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...At last, huh. Sister's Classic race...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"I can't wait~! If it's you, Big Sis, 
you're definitely gonna win♪"

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: But... Gentil-san is here too...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Well, Cheval, can you imagine it? Big Sis 
losing in the real race?!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...I just can't, you know.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Because Big Sis has always been... strong. 
...Strong enough to make me almost give up 
on catching up to her.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
—Surpassing my sister... is something I 
just can't imagine.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Phew...

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Now then. —Shall we take it off now?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Ah... Gentil-san.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
What's she doing...? ...Oh, she's wearing 
weights—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (BOOOOOOOOM...)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Wahya!?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: ...Hmm.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: —Yes, not bad.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Now then... Let's measure it again.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: —Haaaaaaaaaaaahh!!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
!! W-What incredible power in her 
stride...! —Is she seriously in the Junior 
Class...!?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, wait... did you see that!? 
Gentil-san is running completely 
differently from before...!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Wait, you mean you were holding back...? 
Then those runs you showed me... weren't 
you going all out!?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
“No way!? And here I was secretly taking 
notes from that...!”

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
So that is... Verxina-san's... "unbeatable 
rival"...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"...Isn't this gonna be pretty bad? 
Verxina-san...—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Everyone's preparations were falling into 
place. Let's keep training hard until the 
first leg of the Tiara route, the Oka Sho.
